private-Cargo.toml:
[workspace]
resolver = "3"
members = ["crates/abi", "crates/ipc", "crates/remote", "crates/testdir"]
[workspace.package]
edition = "2024"
license = "MIT"
repository = "https://github.com/hyper-light/shards"
rust-version = "1.98.1"

# Versions are pinned once here.
[workspace.dependencies]
libc = "0.2"
windows-sys = { version = "0.61", features = [
  "Win32_Foundation",
  "Win32_Networking_WinSock",
  "Win32_Security_Cryptography",
  "Win32_Storage_FileSystem",
  "Win32_System_Console",
  "Win32_System_IO",
  "Win32_System_Memory",
  "Win32_System_Registry",
  "Win32_System_SystemInformation",
  "Win32_System_Threading",
  "Win32_UI_Shell",
  "Win32_UI_WindowsAndMessaging",
] }

[workspace.lints.rust]
unsafe_op_in_unsafe_fn = "deny"
missing_debug_implementations = "warn"

[workspace.lints.clippy]
undocumented_unsafe_blocks = "warn"
# Production code never panics (CLAUDE.md); clippy.toml exempts tests.
unwrap_used = "deny"
expect_used = "deny"
panic = "deny"
panic_in_result_fn = "deny"
todo = "deny"
unimplemented = "deny"
unreachable = "deny"
indexing_slicing = "deny"
string_slice = "deny"
print_stdout = "deny"
print_stderr = "deny"

# The TLS provider builds from our vendored copies (vendor/README.md).
[patch.crates-io]
aws-lc-rs = { path = "vendor/aws-lc-rs" }
aws-lc-sys = { path = "vendor/aws-lc-sys" }
rquickjs-sys = { path = "vendor/rquickjs-sys" }

[profile.release]
opt-level = 3
lto = "fat"
codegen-units = 1
panic = "abort"
debug = "line-tables-only"

# Guest binaries: small, fully stripped (they ship inside every microVM).
[profile.guest]
inherits = "release"
opt-level = "s"
debug = false
strip = true

# Test builds (CI, the gates): release's optimizations without its fat LTO and single
# codegen unit, which re-optimize every dependency in each of ~130 test binaries' links:
# 3,147 of a clean test build's 4,466 unit-seconds, against 456 of 1,414 without (M156).
# Releases, and every measurement of shards, keep `release`; `cargo test --profile
# test-release` builds the VM and network processes and the guests it carries with
# these too (crates/shards/build.rs).
[profile.test-release]
inherits = "release"
lto = false
codegen-units = 16

# The guests of a test build: `guest`, without fat LTO, as `test-release` is.
[profile.guest-test]
inherits = "guest"
lto = false
codegen-units = 16

[profile.dev]
panic = "abort"
